parameters.query:
SELECT c.claim_id, c.visit_id, c.status, c.latest_version, c.note_signed_at, d.payload
FROM claims c
JOIN claim_drafts d ON d.claim_id = c.claim_id AND d.version = c.latest_version AND d.kind = 'draft'
WHERE c.claim_id = $1
INSERT INTO dedup_keys (key, meta) VALUES ($1, $2::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key
SELECT submitted_at, run_id, edi_control_number FROM submissions WHERE visit_id = $1

WITH a AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, run_id, metadata)
  VALUES ('Workflow Engine', 'system', 'Duplicate trigger suppressed', 'Claim ' || $1::text, $1::text, $2::text, $3::text,
          jsonb_build_object('dedup_key', $2::text || '+submitted', 'suppressed_by', 'visit_id + claim_status'))
  RETURNING id
) SELECT count(*)::int AS written FROM a

parameters.query:
WITH d AS (
  DELETE FROM dedup_keys WHERE key = $1 RETURNING key
), a AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, patient_id, run_id, version, metadata)
  VALUES ('Workflow Engine', 'system', 'Submission failed', 'Claim ' || $2::text, $2::text, $3::text, $4::text, $5::text, $6::text, jsonb_build_object('error', $7::text))
  RETURNING id
) SELECT count(*)::int AS released FROM d

parameters.query:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 AS n FROM claim_drafts WHERE claim_id = $1
), sv AS (
  INSERT INTO claim_drafts (claim_id, visit_id, version, kind, run_id, payload)
  SELECT $1, $2, n, 'submitted', $3, $6::jsonb FROM v RETURNING version
), sub AS (
  INSERT INTO submissions (visit_id, claim_id, run_id, edi_control_number, submitted_at, submitted_by, payload)
  VALUES ($2, $1, $3, $4, $5::timestamptz, $7, $6::jsonb) RETURNING visit_id
), cl AS (
  UPDATE claims SET stage = 'submitted', status = 'submitted', submitted_at = $5::timestamptz WHERE claim_id = $1 RETURNING claim_id
), m AS (
  INSERT INTO claim_metrics (claim_id, visit_id, doctor_id, note_signed_at, submitted_at, proposed_count, changed_count)
  SELECT $1, $2, c.doctor_id, c.note_signed_at, $5::timestamptz, $9::int, $10::int FROM claims c WHERE c.claim_id = $1
  RETURNING claim_id
), au AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (ts, actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, patient_id, code, previous_value, new_value, run_id, version, metadata)
  SELECT COALESCE(ts::timestamptz, now()), actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, patient_id, code, previous_value, new_value, run_id,
         COALESCE(version, 'Submitted v' || (SELECT version FROM sv)), COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($8::jsonb) AS x(ts text, actor text, actor_type text, event text, entity text, claim_id text, visit_id text, patient_id text, code text, previous_value text, new_value text, run_id text, version text, metadata jsonb)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT version FROM sv) AS version, (SELECT count(*) FROM au)::int AS audit_written, (SELECT count(*) FROM sub)::int AS submission_rows
